description.narrative: This project delivers technical assistance across the Commonwealth Secretariat to better integrate gender equality into programmes and operations. Technical assistance to Commonwealth small states for gender mainstreaming will also be provided. This will include, inter alia, technical assistance and capacity building to enable policy and legislative reform in member countries to end violence against women and girls. The programme will embed activities related to consensus building on gender equality and social inclusion. Therefore, this work will foster consensus and advance key priority issues in member countries, including supporting implementation of initiatives on the four Gender Equality priorities: (i) women’s economic empowerment; (ii) women in leadership; (iii) ending violence against women and girls; and (iv) gender and climate change.
